messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up 1 Meera at Arborea submitted a vendor risk form asking for KMS/BYOK support, SOC2 evidence, subprocessors, and key rotation policy. File attached: https://files.company/arborea-risk.xlsx :file_folder:
aj_security: do we have a canonical BYOK answer? I recall CMK only for Dedicated/private, Hosted uses provider-managed keys with envelope encryption.
sam_se: exact: CMKs (customer-controlled keys) supported for Dedicated or Private deployments. For Hosted we offer tenant-isolated keys and envelope encryption; we can provide audit logs and attestations but not customer ARNs in our control plane.
ev an_legal: also they'll want the DPA version and a subcontractor list. We should offer SOC2 Type II under NDA. Word it as: "SOC2 Type II report available upon NDA; DPA v2.3 governs processing; subprocessors list provided on request."
maria_cs: @rita_customer can you confirm whether Arborea is leaning toward Dedicated? They ticked "required" for customer-managed keys on Q12.
rita_customer: Meera replied: they prefer Dedicated for compliance but are cost-sensitive. They need sample KMS ARNs, a sample key policy showing least-privilege, and rotation cadence. Contract review expected EOW.
aj_security: I'll draft a one-page KMS summary + minimal policy snippet. Keep ARNs templated.
sam_se: paste for the questionnaire (we'll sanitize ARNs): ```KMS Example (Dedicated): arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789
Key rotation: customer-managed keys should rotate annually; we recommend 90-day rotation for high-sensitivity data. Hosted flow: provider-managed CMK with envelope encryption; audit logs available for key usage.```
ev an_legal: add this sentence for procurement: "Redwood will provide a current SOC2 Type II report under NDA; the applicable DPA is v2.3. Our subprocessors list may be requested and will be shared under standard confidentiality terms."
maria_cs: Action list: (1) @sam_se finalize and attach questionnaire responses, (2) @aj_security provide the KMS architecture blurb & sample key policy, (3) @evan_legal attach DPA link and SOC2 instructions. I will send the consolidated reply to Meera tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
vendor-bot: Uploaded arborea-risk.xlsx (9.6 KB)
rita_customer: Meera also wants a least-privilege key policy example for the BYOK flow that auditors can review. Can we include a short policy snippet?
aj_security: short sanitized example (will remove account IDs before sending): ```{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/RedwoodKMSHandler"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:DescribeKey"],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:RequestTag/Project": "arborea"}}
    }
  ]
}```I'll sanitize before we attach.
sam_se: note for the draft reply: offer a lower-cost alternative: Dedicated with a dedicated tenant + audit streaming sometimes satisfies auditors without full BYOK. Worth proposing if budget is a blocker.
maria_cs: good call. I'll include that option in the reply and ask Meera for their auditor's acceptance criteria.
ev an_legal: I'll prep the DPA link and a short note on subprocessors. Once the team signs off, I'll send the DPA + SOC2 instructions under NDA.
maria_cs: I'll assemble and post the draft here for quick review before sending. Thanks all.
